scope: Audit of agent replies that report cart changes not applied (pending from batch 96) and quantity phrases that added units instead of setting them
audit: Simulated agent claiming «agregué / quité / cambié / actualicé / eliminé / añadí / lo dejé en 2» with and without actions, 8 message types (thanks, chit-chat, schedule, delay, parking, laughter, third party) in building_cart, awaiting_name, awaiting_payment and awaiting_final_confirm: 288 combinations
baselineFindings: Main agent path: only «agregué/añadí» without items fell back to the rules; a reply claiming a quantity change, removal, update or deletion with no action was relayed in building_cart (chit-chat recorded as order_progress)
Off-topic branch (batch 96 guard): «ya lo dejé en 2» was not in the claim list, relayed in every state for schedule or delay questions
«déjalo en 2 combos», «ponlo en 3 …», «cámbialo a 2 …» and «mejor 2 combos» added units (1 → 3) in both modes; «que sean 2 combos» already set the quantity
The plural matcher reduced «naturales/personales/panes» to «naturale/personale/pane», so «mejor 2 limonadas naturales» did not match the line
fix: replyClaimsCartChange (add, remove, change, update, delete, adjust, replace, «lo dejé…», «he …») shared by the off-topic branch and a new main-path guard: a reply that reports a cart change while no action at all is applied falls back to the rules (warning agent_claimed_change_without_actions). parseCartQuantityCorrection reads «déja/pon/cambia + lo/la/los/las + en/a + N + product»; the cart handler reads «mejor N <product>» only when exactly one cart line matches (otherwise it may be a switch) and «déjalo en N» with a single line; plural matching drops «-es» after vowel + l/r/n/d/j.
